stage: Palimpsest-CI3 — Evidence Identity, Staleness & Revision-Scoped Authority

selectionProducerCommit.reason: §18 requires executable producers to live in the Code Freeze, not the Evidence Freeze. CI2 had to make the same correction; recording it makes the pattern visible rather than silent.

theDefect.cause: Two lookups answer 'is this observation already recorded'. The delegated route reads the evidence projection filtered to status='active'; the shared writer reads the event log by idempotency key. After an EVIDENCE_STALE they disagree, and the writer returned the REVOKED event as the observation just taken.
theDefect.consequence: A false qualification CLAIM, not unsafe promotion — the Gate already read the authority column, so no stale atom could authorize anything.
theDefect.correction: src/tools/work_evidence.ts: findRecordedEvidence now also reads the atom's current authority from the projection, and requireActive refuses to converge on a revoked atom. It refuses rather than re-recording because one idempotency key cannot carry two authorities.

cases.F1_replay: converges; no second atom, no second ATTEMPT_COMPLETED, no promotion
cases.F2_conflict: a differing exit code is refused, naming both observations
cases.F3_two_candidates: disjoint subjects, atoms and dependency digests; a candidate-scoped gate names only its own
cases.F4_contract_change: basisDigest differs between contracts, and appears in no atom; the old atoms still satisfy a gate written under the other standard — THE UNCLOSED GAP
cases.F5_timestamp: created_at is in every atom and in no key
cases.F6_reevaluation: a second attempt is a new subject; identical content is refused as NO_WORK

mechanism.trigger: a plan revision that retires a task (removal or typed invalidation)
mechanism.scope: the retired tasks and their attempts, matched as exact (subject_type, subject_id) pairs
mechanism.commitSubjectAtoms: excluded from the automatic policy and reported in excludedBySubjectType
mechanism.ordering: EVIDENCE_STALE commits inside the same atomic batch, BEFORE PROJECT_REVISED
mechanism.history: the evidence_json blob is never rewritten; only the projection status column moves

staleness.policyFinding: invalidation follows TASK RETIREMENT, not the revision number — a revision that retires nothing revokes nothing

gate.seventhCaseLocation: ci3_staleness_applicability.test.ts R3 (a real revision produces the staleness)

results.differentContract: INCOMPLETE, satisfied clause still reported satisfied

promotion.P2: the Git head does NOT move while the plan revision does; promoteWhenGatePasses returns promoted:false with the gate's verdict; zero PROMOTION_* events; candidate not in the canonical tree
promotion.P3: after a real promotion advances the head, exactly one PROMOTION_COMMITTED and the canonical tree holds the promoted content
promotion.P4: a cached PASS is held across a revocation, then promote() is called with NO gate argument; refused with typed blockers, nothing written
promotion.P4_finding: the verdict is never carried into the mutation boundary — promote() calls assessEligibility, which calls GateEngine.evaluate again against the live projection. A projection-delay window in which a cached verdict carries authority does not exist in this design, and that is proved by exhausting the qualification and promoting with no gate at all.
promotion.independentObservation: promotionEligibility(attemptId, 'gate-release') returns eligible:true before the revocation and eligible:false with a gate_not_pass blocker after it

ladder: A1 qualifies under revision 0 through real delegation: 3 active atoms, Gate PASS
an authorized typed invalidation retires A1's task: A1's atoms stale, Gate INCOMPLETE, task STALE
E1 survives with the same evidence ids and bytes, still naming candidate A1
the retained task becomes READY; the scheduler reaches TASK_STARTED; a new attempt runs a new worker body and a new evaluation
new atoms: new ids, disjoint from A1's, all palimpsest-delegated-settlement, all naming candidate B2
Gate PASS on B2's evidence only
promoteWhenGatePasses succeeds and the head advances; the canonical tree holds B2's content
requalification.mechanismNote: the promotion is a merge, so the resulting head is the merge commit — the candidate is asserted as an ANCESTOR of the promoted head, not as the head itself

compatibility.oneWriterTwoRoutes: same three predicates, different producers; no delegated atom carries the Finish producer
compatibility.trajectory: evidence ids and stale events survive; EVIDENCE_STALE carries causation_id null, so an ordering is not promoted into causality; the Gate reads no trajectory view

established: the product distinguishes a replay of one verified fact from a genuinely different observation, and refuses to let a conflict inherit an earlier PASS
a candidate's evidence is bound to its own attempt, so a different candidate cannot spend it
a plan revision that retires a task revokes exactly that work's evidence authority, in the same atomic batch and before the revision it belongs to
a revocation never rewrites history: the atom's bytes, id, command, exit code, producer and created_at all survive, and EVIDENCE_STALE is an additive fact
the normal Gate excludes stale and foreign evidence and reports absence as INCOMPLETE, never FAIL
promotion re-derives the gate and the input world inside its own mutation boundary, so a cached PASS carries no authority and a stale PASS cannot cross it
a legitimate candidate can regain applicable qualification after its predecessor's evidence expired, through a new attempt, with the Gate passing on the new atoms alone and promotion succeeding
the Finish path's atom shape, predicates and producers are unchanged, and both routes still reach one writer with different attribution
the Trajectory projection preserves the evidence identity and the staleness history without turning an ordering into a causal relation
notEstablished: contract identity on the atom: basisDigest exists and is normative but is recorded nowhere, so an atom cannot say which bar it met (F4)
crash recovery from a real process kill between export and evaluation: the windows are measured as re-derivability
a green broad non-gate run: both attempts exited 1 on 30s timeouts, with zero assertion failures
two live model-driven runtime Agents: the carrier and worker ports remain test-owned
limitationsCarried: the atom blob still says status:'active' after revocation; the projection column is the authority
subject_digest is written and read by nothing
a STALE task cannot return to READY, so requalification needs a new task
the stale deployment copy in the real runtime home is unchanged and not on the executed path
rc.3 is qualified for the operations exercised, not every Win32 path

disposableProbe.purpose: to run the same suites and the same broad selection at the CI2 Evidence Freeze, so an environment-induced timeout could be separated from a CI3-caused one
disposableProbe.nodeModulesHandling: linked as a junction from the main worktree; removed with unlinkSync before the tree is deleted, never by descending through it
